questions.text: Read: 'Despite the record-breaking heat and weeks without rain, old Mr. Torres walked his rows of corn every evening, touching each stalk and checking the soil. His neighbors had already given up. But Mr. Torres had survived droughts before.' What can you INFER about Mr. Torres?
options: He is stubborn and doesn't listen to others
He is experienced and determined to save his crop
He is too old to be farming
questions.answer: He is experienced and determined to save his crop

questions.text: Read: 'The investigation revealed that pesticides from the neighboring farm had seeped into the river, causing fish to die in large numbers. Local fishermen reported empty nets for the first time in decades.' What is the CAUSE of the fish dying?
options: The fishermen used the wrong nets
Pesticides from a neighboring farm contaminated the river
A storm changed the river's direction
The fish migrated to a different area
questions.answer: Pesticides from a neighboring farm contaminated the river

questions.text: Read the sentence: 'Her heart was a compass that always pointed home.' This sentence uses a ___
questions.answer: metaphor

questions.text: Read: 'The old windmill groaned and sighed as the dust storm rolled in, as if it knew the hard times ahead.' What literary technique is used?
questions.answer: Personification

questions.text: Read: 'Working on the farm was harder than climbing a mountain.' This is an example of a ___
questions.answer: simile

questions.text: What does the word DROUGHT mean in this sentence: 'The crops failed because the drought had lasted over three months with no rainfall'?
options: A long period with little or no rain
questions.answer: A long period with little or no rain

questions.text: The root word AGRI means 'field or farm.' Using this knowledge, what does AGRICULTURE most likely mean?
options: The science and practice of farming
A type of machine used in factories
questions.answer: The science and practice of farming

questions.text: Read a passage about water conservation. The author ends with: 'Every drop we save today is a drop available for tomorrow's harvest. The choice is ours.' The author's PURPOSE is most likely to ___
options: entertain with a story about farming
questions.answer: persuade readers to conserve water

questions.text: A THEME is different from a SUMMARY because a theme ___
options: lists the events of the story in order
names all the characters in the story
states the central message or life lesson from the story
questions.answer: states the central message or life lesson from the story

questions.text: A story follows a young farmer who fails at everything he tries but keeps working hard. By the end, his persistence leads to a great harvest. What is the most likely THEME?
options: Success requires luck and good weather
Perseverance and hard work lead to success
questions.answer: Perseverance and hard work lead to success

questions.text: In a PROBLEM-SOLUTION text structure, the author ___
options: identifies a problem and explains how it was or could be solved
provides steps to complete a task
questions.answer: identifies a problem and explains how it was or could be solved

questions.text: Which statement is a fact that can be VERIFIED?
options: Texas ranchers are the hardest workers in America.
The Texas longhorn is the official state large mammal of Texas.
Nothing tastes better than Texas beef.
Ranching is more important than farming.
questions.answer: The Texas longhorn is the official state large mammal of Texas.

questions.text: Read: 'First, the seeds are planted in rows. Then, the plants are watered daily. Later, fertilizer is added. Finally, the crops are harvested in autumn.' This text structure is ___
questions.answer: Sequential/Chronological

questions.text: When you SUMMARIZE a passage, you ___
options: copy the passage word for word
write every detail from the passage
state the most important ideas in your own words
write your opinion about the passage
questions.answer: state the most important ideas in your own words

questions.text: Read: 'Rosa felt her stomach drop as the teacher called her name. She walked to the front of the class, her palms sweating.' The phrase 'her stomach drop' means ___
options: She felt sudden fear or nervousness
questions.answer: She felt sudden fear or nervousness

questions.text: A STANZA in a poem is similar to a ___ in prose writing.
questions.answer: paragraph

questions.text: An INTERNAL conflict in a story is when a character struggles ___
options: with their own thoughts, feelings, or decisions
questions.answer: with their own thoughts, feelings, or decisions

questions.text: Read: 'The documentary argued that factory farming causes significant environmental damage. It showed footage of polluted waterways near large farms.' A person evaluating this source should consider ___
options: only the pictures, not the words
whether the source might have a bias or point of view
that documentaries are always completely accurate
only the age of the documentary
questions.answer: whether the source might have a bias or point of view

questions.text: Read: 'The mesquite tree endures blistering heat and goes months without rain, yet it thrives where other trees cannot.' The word ENDURES most closely means ___
questions.answer: survives through

questions.text: In comparing two POINTS OF VIEW in a text, you are examining ___
options: how different people think about or experience the same event or topic
the plot of two different stories
the settings of two different books
questions.answer: how different people think about or experience the same event or topic

questions.text: The PREFIX mis- means 'wrong' or 'badly.' What does MISJUDGE mean?
questions.answer: To judge wrongly or incorrectly

questions.text: Read: 'Corn has been a staple crop of Texas for centuries. It is used for food, animal feed, and even fuel. Without corn, Texas agriculture would look very different.' What would be the BEST heading for this passage?
options: The Many Uses of Corn in Texas
questions.answer: The Many Uses of Corn in Texas

questions.text: In a FIRST-PERSON narrative, the story is told by ___
options: an outside narrator who knows everything
one of the characters using 'I' and 'me'
multiple characters at the same time
the author speaking directly to the reader
questions.answer: one of the characters using 'I' and 'me'

questions.text: Read: 'Fertile soil, reliable rain, and a long growing season make East Texas ideal for farming.' What does FERTILE most likely mean?
options: rich and productive for growing plants
questions.answer: rich and productive for growing plants

questions.text: When an author uses FLASHBACK in a story, the narrative ___
options: jumps forward to show future events
returns to an earlier time to show a past event
repeats the same scene multiple times
speeds through months or years quickly
questions.answer: returns to an earlier time to show a past event
